source_scope: All existing Personal Agent benchmark materials, the api-v2-nothink single-round formal evaluation of five API models across ten synthetic personas, and the product review layer (case library, white-box question grid, role cards, domain taxonomy and review instruments)
transforms: Local workspace paths replaced with <workspace> or <local-path>
Internal runtime session references replaced with <runtime-session-ref>
Root rewritten as a standalone bilingual benchmark README (English + Simplified Chinese)
Deprecated pilot and smoke results archived under persona-*/results/pilot/ and desensitized
Process drafts, research notes and legacy reports removed from the public snapshot

Product review layer normalised from an internal case export: verbatim end-user quotes, external links, platform handles, contact records, reviewer names, internal product names and internal document paths removed
Segment profiles rewritten so that no named individual or vendor survives into the published data
Automated two-level domain tags withheld: spot-check agreement was around half, so the column is omitted rather than published as noise
trace_completeness: See docs/trace-availability.json; structured context and replies are not full execution traces

evaluation_rounds.gpt_runtime: Three-round stability on 252 common items for GPT, Hy4 and MiMo
evaluation_rounds.api_v2_nothink: Single-round formal evaluation of five API models over ten personas; see docs/api-v2-nothink-ranking.md
evaluation_rounds.product_review: White-box case library and question grid; no human review scores have been collected yet, see docs/product-review.md
